[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Dargen Io''' was the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Sector Chief of Supply]] for the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]]. Io was responsible for authorizing the mission to [[Battle for Black Ice|seize]] the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]''.
